scenarios.business_goal: Identify which employees drive the most corporate card spend so finance can review outliers
scenarios.title: Top spenders by employee
scenarios.capability_rationale: Product supports 'ranking and top-N' and 'joins over documented relationships'
success_criteria: names the employees ranked by total card spend
keeps amounts separate per currency or states which currency is used
scenarios.question_intent: rank employees by total card spend

scenarios.business_goal: Track how monthly card spend per merchant category evolves to spot budget drift
scenarios.title: Monthly spend trend by merchant category
scenarios.capability_rationale: Product supports 'single-table aggregation' and 'filtering by date range'
success_criteria: shows card spend per merchant category for each month

scenarios.business_goal: Find out how much may be spent per night on a hotel in Paris before booking
scenarios.title: Hotel limit for a Paris trip
scenarios.capability_rationale: Product supports 'explain per-diem and hotel limits'
success_criteria: states a nightly hotel limit for Paris
scenarios.signature: explanation|book hotel limit night paris spent|supported
scenarios.question_intent: learn the hotel cap for Paris

scenarios.business_goal: Get an expense report approved without leaving the chat

scenarios.signature: how_to|approved chat expense leaving report without|unsupported
